    createPlant:
      path: /plants
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: PlantCreate
        body:
          properties:
            nickname: nullable<string>
            species: string
            legacy_tag:
              type: optional<string>
              name: legacyTag
              availability: deprecated
            internal_notes:
              type: optional<string>
              audiences: &ref_0
                - internal
            label:
              type: optional<string>
              encoding:
                xml:
                  name: Label
                  attribute: true
        content-type: application/json
      response:
        docs: OK
        type: PlantDetails
        status-code: 200
      examples:
        - request:
            nickname: null
            species: species
          response:
            body:
              created_at: '2024-01-15T09:30:00Z'
              nickname: nickname
              internal_notes: internal_notes
              label: label
              id: id
  source:
    openapi: ../openapi.yml

      created_at:
        type: optional<datetime>

      nickname: optional<nullable<string>>
      legacy_tag:
        type: optional<string>
        availability: deprecated
        name: legacyTag
      internal_notes:
        type: optional<string>
        audiences: *ref_0

        encoding:
          xml:
            name: Label
            attribute: true

      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    encoding:
      xml:
        name: PlantMetadata
  PlantDetails:

      nickname: nullable<string>
